candidates.source_name: Hrc informacijski inženiring d.o.o. — reference / O nas (Hibis core banking)
candidates.why_relevant: Hrc is one of the largest Slovenian core-banking software houses (Hibis platform). Its About/References page names its bank and savings-bank clients explicitly — a rare public map of which SI institutions run which core system. Observed named clients include Addiko Bank, BKS Bank AG, Delavska hranilnica, LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava, RCI Banque, NLB, Gorenjska banka, Deželna banka Slovenije, OTP banka, plus HR (Addiko Zagreb, BKS Rijeka, Raiffeisenbank Austria Zagreb) and RS (AIK Banka).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML fetch + diff of /si/o-nas client list and /si/aktualno news index; parse client names into a vendor-bank relationship table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language search for Slovenian banking software suppliers, then direct fetch of the vendor site
queries_used: slovenski dobavitelj programske opreme za banke reference uspešna zgodba implementacija
Hrc Hibis banke hranilnice reference core banking Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Hrc — Aktualno / novice (case studies: Hibis migrations)
candidates.why_relevant: News index carrying project-level case studies that name the bank and the migration: Deželna banka Slovenije migration to Hibis, Hibis as the common platform of the merged OTP banka, and the Nova KBM Hibis implementation. This is exactly the deal-level evidence that the banks themselves never publish.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the news index monthly; fetch each new article; extract (bank, vendor, product, date, project type).
candidates.discovered_via_method: link snowball from hrc.si About page
queries_used: Hrc Hibis banke hranilnice reference core banking Slovenija

candidates.source_name: Halcom d.d. — corporate site (digital banking solutions)
candidates.why_relevant: The best-known Slovenian banking-software exporter (Hal E-Bank, MultiPay, qualified digital certificates, payment hub). Corporate site states market scale (5 markets, ~50 banks, 2 central banks/clearing houses, 700k+ certificates) and carries a dedicated 'For banks and financial institutions' offering page — the base layer for tracking Halcom's product line and positioning.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl solutions + about + newsroom on both halcom.com and halcom.si; diff product pages and claimed customer counts over time.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language seed query on Halcom bank references
queries_used: Halcom banka rešitve reference slovenske banke
Halcom novice reference banka implementacija "instant payments" OR "digitalno bančništvo" projekt

candidates.source_name: Halcom support — 'Banks in Slovenia' / 'List of banks that are using Halcom'
candidates.why_relevant: A vendor support FAQ that effectively publishes Halcom's installed base: which banks in Slovenia (and in other markets) support Hal E-Bank / Halcom certificates. Support-portal FAQs are usually maintained more honestly and more currently than marketing reference pages, so this is a high-value customer-list proxy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the per-country FAQ pages (sl-en, sr-en, etc.) quarterly and diff the bank lists to detect wins/losses.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from Halcom brand query
queries_used: Halcom banka rešitve reference slovenske banke

candidates.source_name: ZZI d.o.o. — bizBox / eCustoms corporate site
candidates.why_relevant: ZZI runs bizBox, a Slovenian e-document exchange network integrated with 68+ ERP/accounting systems and connected to banks and UJP for e-invoice exchange. Reveals the bank-side e-invoicing/e-document rails and which banks participate — an adjacency to payments that foreign vendors compete for.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch About/solutions/partners pages plus any bizBox bank-connectivity list; snowball to zzi.si if that domain is live.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language seed query on ZZI bank solutions
queries_used: ZZI d.o.o. banke rešitve reference e-poslovanje

candidates.source_name: SAOP help — 'Nastavitve za povezavo na ZZI: izmenjava e-računov z bankami in UJP'
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party ERP vendor documentation that confirms the ZZI–bank e-invoice integration path in operational detail. ERP/accounting help portals are a reliable indirect way to learn which banks expose which channels, because they must document real, working connections.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted fetch of ERP help portals (SAOP, Datalab, Vasco, Pantheon) for bank-integration articles; extract bank + channel + intermediary.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from ZZI query results
queries_used: ZZI d.o.o. banke rešitve reference e-poslovanje

candidates.source_name: SRC d.o.o. — Rešitve za bančništvo in finance
candidates.why_relevant: SRC is one of the largest Slovenian system integrators with an explicit banking & finance solutions vertical (e-signature, digital identification, secure e-archive, customer-file / document management, regulatory compliance). It is a prime candidate for localising foreign platforms into SI banks, so its solution pages hint at the underlying foreign products.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /solutions/finance/* plus partner and news sections; extract named OEM/technology partners and any customer logos.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language query on Slovenian integrators for financial institutions

candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. — corporate site (card & payment processing for SI banks)
candidates.why_relevant: Bank-owned domestic processor (owners: NLB, OTP banka, Banka Intesa Sanpaolo, UniCredit Banka Slovenija, Deželna banka Slovenije) running SEPA/instant payment processing, card and ATM processing, POS terminal servicing, call centre and dispute handling for SI banks. It is simultaneously the incumbent competitor and the gatekeeper for any payments vendor entering Slovenia; its own pages describe the service perimeter.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor /podjetje/, /podporne-storitve/ and news/press pages; also track NLB Group's Bankart page for group-level statements.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sl-language query on domestic card processing

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use bizi.si / companywall.si to resolve exact legal entity names, then feed those into si.openprocurements.com and vendor-site crawls. Respect rate limits and paywalled sections.

Because Banka Slovenije and state-owned financial bodies must tender publicly, this is the single best route from a domestic IT house to a named contract, value and date — the deal evidence commercial banks withhold.

Company-name queries reliably return registry aggregators rather than the vendor's own site.

However, no Serbian/Croatian-language searching was done even though Hrc, Halcom and Comtrade all operate HR/RS units whose local sites often name clients the SI sites omit.

brief: Slovenia's bank-supplier landscape is documented almost entirely on the suppliers' own Slovenian-language sites, and the single richest find is Hrc informacijski inženiring, whose Hibis core-banking platform pages publicly name its bank and savings-bank clients (NLB, OTP banka, Gorenjska banka, Deželna banka Slovenije, Addiko, BKS, Delavska hranilnica, LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava, RCI Banque, plus HR and RS institutions) and carry datable migration case studies. Alongside it sit Halcom (whose support FAQ effectively publishes its installed base of banks), SRC (banking & finance vertical), Bankart (the bank-owned domestic card and SEPA/instant-payments processor, and therefore both incumbent competitor and gatekeeper), and a second tier of document/e-archive and analytics houses (ZZI/bizBox, Genis, Mikrografija, IN516HT). Because commercial banks here are private and silent, the reliable cross-checks are structural rather than editorial: si.openprocurements.com and the official eJN portal for Banka Slovenije tenders, bizi.si/companywall.si/AJPES for entity and scale resolution, and the ZBS and GZS ZIT association pages as actor-enumeration pointers. The main unexploited seam is vendor PARTNER pages and job advertisements, which are where a domestic integrator inadvertently names the foreign platform behind a deal the bank never announced.
